rationale.consistency: Mirrors trimPathPrefix's doc-comment style, EqualFold byte comparison, url.PathUnescape error path and 'should be impossible' comment; idiomatic Go switch.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles decoded-vs-escaped, escaped-vs-escaped (case-insensitive hex), escape-required-but-absent, empty suffix and partial matches; %25xx sequences resolve correctly backwards. Multi-byte UTF-8 chars compared byte-wise share the prefix version's weakness.
rationale.scope: Replaces the broken reverse() trick, removes the now-dead reverse helper, touches nothing else; no prefix/query changes.
rationale.readability: Clear lock-step backward scan with a four-case switch, each case commented once; names (iPath/iSuffix, pathEsc/suffixEsc) are self-explanatory.
rationale.robustness: All index accesses guarded (iPath>=3, loop bounds), no panics on malformed input; unescape error returns path unchanged rather than failing loudly.
rationale.maintainability: Self-contained pure function; some conceptual duplication with trimPathPrefix (two separate matchers rather than a shared core), but each is short and readable.
